## Core Products

### INNOMAG Sealless Magnetic Drive Pumps
- Target: Semiconductor / LCD / Photovoltaic
- Key value: High-purity, leak-free fluid transfer
- Certifications: SEMI compliant, US origin

### PTCXPUMP Magnetic Drive Pumps (Self-owned Brand)
- Target: Chemical / Electroplating / Petrochemical / Pharmaceutical
- Key value: Acid/alkali resistant, high-temperature
- Replaces Japanese SANWA MP series

### Pneumatic Diaphragm / Metering Pumps
- Target: Chemical dosing, particle-containing media

### WOOAM PTFE Heat Exchangers
- Target: Semiconductor, precision chemical

### KUROSE Spiral Plate Heat Exchangers
- Target: Industrial, environmental

### FILTER PLUS Filtration Systems
- Target: Industrial fluid/gas filtration

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: What products does Suzhou Gonghai distribute?
A: We distribute magnetic drive pumps (INNOMAG, PTCXPUMP), heat exchangers (WOOAM, KUROSE), filtration systems (FILTER PLUS), and metering/diaphragm pumps.

### Q: What is the difference between magnetic drive pumps and traditional sealed pumps?
A: Magnetic drive pumps use magnetic coupling without mechanical seals, completely eliminating seal leakage risk. They are ideal for hazardous, corrosive, or high-purity media.

### Q: Why choose INNOMAG over other brands?
A: INNOMAG is a US brand with 40+ years of expertise in semiconductor-grade high-purity applications, compliant with SEMI standards.

### Q: What is PTCXPUMP?
A: PTCXPUMP is our self-owned brand, designed by our Taiwan R&D team. It offers comparable performance to Japanese SANWA MP series at more competitive pricing.

### Q: How to contact Gonghai?
A: Phone 0512-62570717 or visit https://www.szkhai.com.cn
